name: Interior
_design: The name survives from the old build and only here: a Waystation is the roadside kind of clinic, and this is the only genuinely roadside one in Caelora -- an hour of plank from Emberfall, an hour and a half from Mirehaven, on its own piles, in the middle of a marsh. It exists because the route is long, foggy and honestly a bit dangerous, and a route that is honestly a bit dangerous needs one room in the middle of it that is not.
_plan: Everything in the room is about the fog and the lamps. A third of the floor is the oil store -- barrels, funnels, trimmed wicks, and a chalked roster of who lit which span and when -- because that roster is the entire reason the causeway is passable after dark, and it says so better than anybody could. The rest is three sets of bunks, a stove that has never gone out, and a bell rope that goes up through the ceiling to the fog bell on post 6 outside, which is the tile the player walked past on the way in.

text: A brass terminal, and a bucket under it catching what comes off the ceiling.
THE ROOST, stencilled on the side. Kin you cannot carry wait here.
The oil store. Fourteen barrels, a funnel, and a rack of trimmed wicks.
Chalked on the boards above it: SPANS 1-6 SORREL. 7-11 NOBODY. 12-14 ADDA.
Somebody has written NOBODY four times and rubbed it out three.
The stove, and a kettle that has not been cold since the place was built.
Over the counter, the restorative bank, lamps in green.
The Waystation keeps the road's hours, and on this road that is all of them.
A rope comes down through the ceiling and ends in a loop at chest height.
It goes up to the fog bell on post 6. Rung at dusk, and for anybody late.
A card beside it: TWO FOR THE HOUR. FIVE IF YOU ARE LOST. DO NOT BE CLEVER.
A crate of survey stakes, opened and mostly empty, addressed to nobody here.
The stamp on the lid is a circle with a line through it.
Under the crate, a note for two hundred more, and a date next week.
